text:
maria: Heads-up — need a single runbook for the Datadog + OpenTelemetry export for the marketplace listing. PM wants one link for SI partners and marketplace reviewers.
aj: Agreed. We should include both collector config and the Datadog dashboard JSON template. Also clear network/firewall steps for VPC/private exports.
devon: I can draft sampling guidance and GPU-specific trace tags. Will drop a collector snippet here in a sec.
devon: ```
# otel-collector-config.yml (minimal snippet)
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DD_API_KEY}  # instruct partners to use KMS/HSM for keys
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
sam: For dashboards, include 3 widgets: latency (p50/p95), token throughput (tokens/sec), and model-fallback count. I'll prepare a JSON template and example queries.
maria: Add an onboarding note: start with 100% sampling during onboarding, then switch to 1% steady-state. Tag traces with model, region, and route.
devon: Also add KV-cache and prefix-cache events as spans. Correlate with logs via req_id in trace context.
deploy-bot: integration-test: otel->datadog export pipeline smoke passed on staging (build/obs-export-231) :white_check_mark:
elaine: We need an SI-ready checklist for NeonEdge: access requirements, approved IP ranges, and a troubleshooting stanza for rate-limited exporters. @sam can you join their onboarding call next Tue?
sam: Yep — calendar invite sent. I'll bring the dashboard draft and the exporter snippet. Dashboard template link (staging): https://redwood.dev/marketplace/obs-templates/dd-otlp-dashboard-staging
maria: :thumbsup: I'll assemble the runbook page with staging checklist (auth, firewall, sample payloads, expected metrics) and add an example curl payload for tracing:```
# example trace ingest
curl -X POST http://collector.local:4318/v1/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"resourceSpans": [...], "traceId": "abc123", "req_id": "r-42"}'
```
aj: Suggest adding a short troubleshooting flow: 1) verify OTLP connection, 2) check DD API key and rate limits, 3) confirm trace tagging. Keep it one page for SIs.
maria: Good call. I'll finish the draft today and ping the partners channel when it's live.
